limitations: A cluster is not a task. It is a set of errors sharing a normalized signature; cutting a task from it is a human judgement this tool does not make.

Cluster signatures are operand-blind (errors.mjs normalizes quoted operands to '<S>'), so exclusion patterns match mostly on PATHS. A frozen task whose paths this list names wrongly will not be caught by its message.
The exclusion patterns are deliberately broad, because a false exclusion costs one candidate while a false inclusion contaminates a frozen pilot that cannot be un-run.
index_signal describes what the INDEX knows about the files, not how hard the work is.
